name: Saotome Marimo
source:
Twin sister of the Saotome family.

In contrast to her older sister, she always has a calm tone. She tends to be a bit tongue-tied.

She is a novelist and boasts a considerable amount of knowledge, but her lack of real-life experience is a source of worry.

She envies Maria, who is able to talk with the main character without hesitation. The topic of breasts is forbidden in front of her.
